questions.question: What did Hannah pray for at the tabernacle?
What did Hannah promise about the son she asked for?
options: To teach him the law of Moses well
To give him to the LORD all his life
To raise him to become a great king
To bring him to the temple each year
questions.answer: To give him to the LORD all his life

questions.question: The priest Eli at first thought Hannah was drunk as she prayed silently.
Hannah named her son _____, saying she had asked the LORD for him.
Hannah brought the boy to serve the LORD at the tabernacle in _____.
